reports/IN_Market_Intelligence.html.summary: Indian market is in a Downtrend (Nifty 50 22,600.00, only 10.2% of stocks above their 50-DMA): hold maximum cash, trim Stage 4 holdings and add no new momentum longs; three conditional setups are sized at zero until the Nifty 50 closes above 23,403.72 for three sessions.

Bull List has only 20 names (2 confirmed); IT is the only convincing leading sector; Bear List 30 names led by utilities, realty, metals and autos
FIIs net sold 51,466 Cr in October and are 89.6% short index futures; DIIs bought 59,110 Cr
Conditional setups: ANANDRATHI (R:R 3.37 at close), CYIENT and INDHOTEL (watch only until pullback); watchlist gains all three
RNITAI (23.52%) and SEDEMAC (14.47%) fail the 0.5% pre-event gap test

reports/IN_Portfolio_Audit.html.summary: India portfolio audit for the 23 October 2026 session in a Downtrend: sell 11 positions (10 exits and the RNITAI trim) for about ₹1.88 million, buy nothing, raise cash from 0.09% to 45.0% and cut effective market exposure from 88.9% to 43.0%.
highlights: RNITAI is 23.52% of net worth against a 15% hard cap and fails the cash-conversion red line, so the Let-Winners-Run rule cannot protect it; trim 4,000 of 10,000 shares to 14.11%.

Four holdings (ASTRAMICRO, NETWEB, AFCOM, TDPOWERSYS) closed under their own written stops and six fail a red line (INTERARCH, TARIL, WELENT, ORIANA-SM, BLISSGVS, BALUFORGE): exit all ten at Monday's open.
No shortlisted company passes all three gates at a buyable price; seven conditional limit orders are sized by Risk-Unit Sizing but stay inactive until results and support conditions are met.
Nine retained positions each carry a written stop; money at risk to stops falls from 6.69% to 5.63% of net worth, inside the 12.0% ceiling; SEDEMAC at 14.47% is the largest remaining exposure.
NETWEB filed record results on Saturday 24 October, after the session cutoff; the stop rule that fired on Friday's close is kept and the event is disclosed.
